placeId.title: Google place_id
placeId.description: The Google Maps place_id of the venue to scrape (e.g. ChIJ84FTuLhG0i0R1rMrarZInMo).

maxReviews.title: Max reviews (0 = unlimited)
maxReviews.description: Stop after collecting this many new reviews. Leave at 0 for a full backfill.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: "newest" sorts the review feed before scrolling. "relevant" leaves Google's default order and skips the sort step.

useProxy.title: Use proxy
useProxy.description: Off by default — this project has run without a proxy since v1 and proxying has never been required for Google Maps the way it is for TripAdvisor. Turn on to route each setup retry through a rotated proxy session (see proxyConfiguration below) instead of a direct connection.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Only used when "Use proxy" above is on. Each fresh-browser-context setup retry (see MAX_SETUP_ATTEMPTS in main.py) picks up a new proxy session, so a retry after a failed Newest-sort attempt gets a different egress IP, not just a new browser/cookies.
